title: claude.ai ClickUp MCP fails mid-session with mcp_oauth_token_read_unsupported, persists after user says it's back
details:
- **What happened:** ClickUp connector calls (get_task, get_task_comments, get_threaded_comments) worked early in the session, then every call started failing with permission_error "The stored OAuth token for this server cannot be read with this request's credential." (error_code mcp_oauth_token_read_unsupported). The same error came back after the user said ClickUp was back up.
- **What the user said:** "clickup should be back up again... try"
- **Repro:** Long session using claude.ai ClickUp MCP tools; after roughly an hour, all ClickUp tool calls return the error above; retrying in the same session doesn't help.
- **Evidence:** request_ids req_011CfXsm4yeVwAbfFP6bUGrg, req_011CfXsmTtJWtn5CtfkLCC3V, req_011CfXtVNmeNUF4FdKmX17jN, req_011CfXtVVJYfNqdXAB9sfmAU; 2026-09-29
